newsitem.title: UK: Ladbroke up on talk of bid from ITT.
newsitem.headline: Ladbroke up on talk of bid from ITT.

text.p: Shares in Ladbroke Group Plc climbed on Monday after newspaper reports that the British hotel and betting company could be the subject of a bid from ITT Corp of the U.S.
By 0842 GMT Ladbroke shares were four pence firmer at 233.
"There's a bit of talk about a possible bid and that's been drawing some speculative buying," one marketmaker said.
The Independent on Sunday newspaper said ITT was considering a bid for Ladbroke in an effort to ward of a hostile takeover attempt by Hilton Hotels Corp.

Ladbroke shares fell last week after Hilton's bid for ITT was announced. Hilton was considered a potential candidate to take over Ladbroke and analysts said the bid for ITT made a Hilton acquisition of Ladbroke less likely.
